title: Evict stale DB connections before async Replay Vision activities
answers: Why are Replay Vision observations missing thumbnails after a database connection drop?
How does track_activity handle stale database connections in async Temporal activities?
Why do async Replay Vision activities fail on dead Django DB connections?
body:
Symptom: Replay Vision observations permanently fail or miss thumbnails after a dropped database connection.
Root cause: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/decorators.py:track_activity only closed stale connections before sync activities, leaving dead connections on the worker thread during async ORM calls.
Fix pattern: Run await sync_to_async(close_stale_db_connections)() before async activity execution when not settings.TEST.
Constraints: Applies to async Temporal activities in Replay Vision; skipped in tests (settings.TEST) where touching connections fails without DB access.
applies: Async Temporal activities using Django ORM in products/replay_vision
